name: Murud-Janjira Fort
tagline: An island sea fort that was never conquered — boat access only, no elevation gain
trailhead: Rajapuri jetty, ~5 km from Murud town
seoTitle: Murud-Janjira Fort Solo Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo traveler's guide to Murud-Janjira, Maharashtra's famous unconquered island sea fort — boat access, safety, and what to expect.
dataNote: This is a boat-access island fort visit, not a hiking trek — included here as part of Maharashtra's coastal/Konkan sea fort circuit, which is lighter-weight and different in character from the Sahyadri categories above.

seasons.label: Oct – Feb
seasons.sub: Calmest seas, most reliable boat crossings

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — rough seas can suspend boat services

routeOptions.name: Sailboat from Rajapuri jetty
routeOptions.duration: 15–20 min crossing + 1–2 hrs on the fort
routeOptions.notes: Built by the Siddis, this island fort was never successfully conquered historically. Purely a boat trip and walk — no trekking involved.

safety.intro: The main safety factor here is sea conditions for the boat crossing, not any physical trekking risk.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Check sea conditions — boat services can be suspended in rough monsoon weather
Confirm the last return boat time before you disembark

cards.title: On the trail
items: Fort interior has uneven, weathered stone — watch your footing
Limited shade — carry water and sun protection

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Very tourist-friendly and safe for solo travelers
Boats generally only run with enough passengers — you'll rarely be alone
